explication: SyncTV is a real-time synchronized video-watching platform. A client or administrator uses its HTTP, gRPC, or WebSocket surfaces to authenticate, manage rooms and media, and coordinate playback; realtime services distribute room events, while provider integrations supply playable media. The product also supports live publishing and playback, file storage, and clustered operation. The graph combines documented capabilities with relationships visible in sampled source references; several feature implementations were not sampled, so their connections are shown only where documented or left unlinked.
